en-CA.description:
Level up in real life.

Fit Pixel turns your healthy habits into XP for a pixel-art character that gets stronger as you do. Log your day, keep your streak alive, and watch your Pixel level up.

YOUR DAY IS A QUEST LOG
• Log food, water, workouts, sleep and weight in a couple of taps
• Search foods with full macros, save your go-to meals, or add your own
• Steps, sleep, active calories, resting heart rate and weight sync from Apple Health
• Set daily goals and fill every bar

EARN XP, LEVEL UP
• Every goal you hit earns XP, and every 100 XP is a new level
• Keep a daily streak going and watch your flame grow from Spark to Legend
• Your Pixel bulks up as you level: more muscle at level 5, and more again at level 15
• Your Pixel reacts to your day: Zzz after a short night, sweat after a big burn, a glowing bottle when you hit your water goal

TRAIN WITH A PLAN
• Answer a few questions and get a workout plan: full body, upper/lower, push-pull-legs, dumbbell-only or bodyweight
• Workout mode logs every set and rep, with a built-in rest timer
• Fit Pixel tells you when it's time to add weight
• Earn XP for every set you finish

BUILD YOUR PIXEL
• 170 items to collect, from Common to Legendary
• Pick skin tone, hair, eyes, tops, bottoms, shoes, bottles and bags
• Choose the gym your Pixel trains in, from a neon purple gym to an Italian courtyard
• Hit your weight goals to win earned-only gear like the Purple Bottle and the Gold King Bag

MULTIPLAYER
• Climb the leaderboard against your friends, or against everyone on Fit Pixel
• Find your gym on the map and join its chat
• Add friends, check out their Pixels and message them directly
• Report or block anyone in a tap. We have zero tolerance for abuse

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Fit Pixel only reads Health data, never writes it
• Health data stays on your phone unless you save it as a habit log
• We never sell your data or use it for advertising

Fit Pixel is free. Questions? hello@fitpixel.app
en-CA.promoText: Your workouts are now a game. Earn XP for steps, water, sleep and training, level up a pixel-art character, and chat with the people at your gym.
en-CA.title: Fit Pixel: Level Up Fitness
en-CA.subtitle: Pixel-art habit & workout RPG
